notes.title: Dames4Games Showcase
notes.content: [p]Happy to announce that Bookbinding will be participating in the Dames4Games Summer Showcase tomorrow! Thank you, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45664741/sale/Dames4GamesSlumberPartyShowcase?snr=1_2300_4__salesmartsaleeventsonly"]Dames4Games[/url], for this amazing opportunity![/p]

notes.title: Join our Discord!
notes.content: [p]Want to leave feedback on the playtest? Ask the developers a question? Discuss the game with other players? Join our Discord: [url="https://t.co/qAR1wpHHQY"]https://t.co/qAR1wpHHQY[/url][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576185/458f9fa23f3ff3268af7d3c656dff879c638df02.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Playtest is live!
notes.content: [p]Open playtest for Bookbinding is live! To join, click the 'Join the Playtest' button on the Steam page or download the game from Itch.io. You can expect:[/p][list][*][p]Nameable, gender-neutral protagonist[/p][/*][*][p]About 15-20 minutes of gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]5 books to decorate[/p][/*][*][p]4 characters to meet[/p][/*][*][p]1  (or 2?) murders to hide[/p][/*][/list]
